name: 16-bit arcade
promptTemplate: Transform the uploaded subject and environment into a Retro 16-Bit Arcade Fighting Game Pixel Art. Preserve identity while redesigning wardrobe into bold, readable arcade-character shapes. Name the character 'Player 1" and pose the subject as a full body character with exaggerated expressions. Avoid modern vector pixel polish. Rebuild the environment as a detailed side-view fighting-game stage with layered pixel scenery, dramatic lighting, and period-appropriate arcade interface elements.
promptHints: Detailed, expressive photo with a full body view of a person in the foreground as the main subject

exampleImages.alt: A pixel-art fighter in a red jacket and blue trousers poses on a neon-lit 16-bit arcade stage.
